Theme

Church life

divine power noun

also divine will, deity, divinity, godhead, a god

classical

Cic. Div. 1.120: deō, cujus nūminī pārent omnia (Lewis & Short)
Liv. 1.21.1: caeleste nūmen (Lewis & Short)
Tac. Ann. 1.10: templa et effigiēs nūminum (Lewis & Short)

nūmen, nūminis n.

noun, third declension

the will and power of a god; a deity

Properly a nod of the head, hence a command; then a god’s will and sway, the classical sense; then the god (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • dī inmortālēs suō nūmine atque auxiliō sua templa atque urbis tēcta dēfendunt

    the immortal gods defend their temples and the houses of the city with their own power and helpCic. Cat. 2.29 (Lewis & Short)

See also God, goddess, temple.
